messages.subject: Add colors to colors "PCA residuals" graph
parts:
Hi!

There is some easy way to assign colors by groups in the "PCA residuals" graph resulting from the ProcD.lm () function? For example in the function:

plotTangentSpace(BiSym2$symm.shape, axis1 = 1, axis2 = 2, warpgrids = TRUE, mesh = NULL,
                 label = TRUE, groups = Classifier2$Familia, legend=TRUE)

I want to be able to do the same in this graph but I can't.




Thank you!!

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Add colors to colors "PCA residuals" graph
parts:
Sonia,

That particular plot is one of several diagnostic plots, a tool for evaluating residuals.  There are not options to decorate these plots.  But as the title indicates, it is a PCA of model residuals.  Therefore, like Dean suggested, you can extract the residuals from the procD.lm object and use gm.prcomp to reproduce the plot, and decorate it any way you want.

Mike
